name: real-10-stop
what: Stopping the real program while a command it started is still running: through the SDK's AbortSignal, and through Tarsee's killTree(). What the caller sees, and whether the command survives.

made_with.program: codex 0.167.0 (the real pinned program), started with the argument list, environment and stdin the SDK produced

sdkAbort.how: runStreamed(input, { signal }) and signal.abort() while the program's own command is running
